critique_history.assessment:
- The leaflets read as long, flat wings rather than small rounded clover leaves; shorten and broaden their heart-shaped silhouettes.
- All views show the cluster nearly edge-on, hiding the radial arrangement; give the leaflets stronger upward tilt and gentle doming.
- The rendered color is too pale for dark green; use substantially deeper green materials.

- The pale mint coloration does not match the requested dark green; use substantially darker leaf and stem materials.
- Leaflets tilt nearly edge-on and overlap, making the four-part radial clover cluster unclear; flatten and spread them around the junction.
- The long stem visually overwhelms the undersized crown; enlarge the leaflets slightly and shorten/thin the stem.
